source: Trilliant Health ORIA parsed hospital MRF DuckDB files
referenceDateRule: latest data_downloaded date among the source files read (not the build date)
staleRule: stale = priceVintage more than 18 months before referenceDate

contract.codeMatching: explicit MS-DRG:/CPT:/HCPCS: token in all_codes; typed columns alone are not trusted; codes with modifiers/suffixes rejected
contract.scope: one canonical scope per procedure (procedures.json 'scope'); MS-DRG lines must be inpatient/both (or unspecified) and not professional; CPT/HCPCS lines must be billing_class facility and setting outpatient or both
contract.cash: discounted_cash only; cashLow/High = min/max across accepted lines, cashMedian = median
contract.negotiated: standard_charge_dollar per payer+plan (median per plan when a plan has several lines), then median/min/max across plans; per diem and percent-of-total-billed-charges methodologies excluded; percentages, algorithms and estimated_amount never used; payerCount = distinct payer+plan pairs
contract.grossCharge: median gross charge across accepted lines; never used as cash
contract.bounds: values <= 0, >= 500000 or sentinels (e.g. 999999999) dropped per value; cash and payer rates below the procedure floor dropped
contract.hospitalMatching: exact CCN if the source has one (Trilliant files have none); else identical distinctive name tokens + same state + same city or ZIP; else one name's tokens containing the other's (>= 2 shared, one non-generic, no unmatched facility-kind word such as rehab/behavioral/LTAC) + same state + same city or ZIP; else identical name tokens + state when the file states no city/ZIP and the name is unique in the state; the file's hospital_name is used only when its location name differs by at most one abbreviation token; files whose locations resolve to more than one CMS hospital are not attached; ambiguous or failed matches are quarantined
contract.hospitalTypeBlocks: Psychiatric and Long-term hospitals: imaging only; Rural Emergency Hospitals: no inpatient_stay procedures
contract.dedupe: one row per CMS hospital + procedure: the row from the source file with the most recent priceVintage wins; ties go to the file with more accepted MRF lines, then to the lexically smallest sourceDataset. Losers are quarantined as row:duplicate_superseded.
contract.mrfUrl: the hospital's own MRF URL from source_metadata.mrf_url when https, else null; sourceDataset = the Trilliant DuckDB package URL
contract.vintage: hospitals.last_updated_on from the MRF, else source_metadata.mrf_last_updated_on; rows without a source date are quarantined

note: Prices are exactly as published in hospital MRFs, parsed by Trilliant Health. Nothing is estimated.
